title: Effects of tapering on performance in endurance athletes: a meta-analysis (Bosquet et al., 2007)
claims: The meta-analysis found that a 2-week taper produced the largest performance improvement in endurance athletes.
Reducing training volume while maintaining training intensity and frequency was associated with the best performance outcomes.
Performance improvements after tapering were observed in time-trial and endurance performance measures.

verification.note: 2026-11-25 复核 PubMed 17762369 摘要；结论与 knowledge-bosquet-2007-taper 一致。
